description: List all trim/engine modifications for a given make/model/year/generation. Useful for drilling into specific engine variants before querying fitment data.

generation.description: Generation slug (e.g., "b9"). Get slugs from list-generations.

make.description: Manufacturer slug (e.g., "audi", "bmw"). Get slugs from list-makes.

model.description: Model slug (e.g., "a4", "3-series"). Get slugs from list-models.

year.description: 4-digit model year 1900-2100 (e.g., 2020). Get valid years from list-years.

name: list-modifications
